scope:
App UI + actual HTTP/media production, with OS speech and AI/Concat protocol fixtures.
NOT native Windows, live AI image generation or native Concat acceptance.
Audio is eSpeak and final fixture export is FFmpeg; the app dispatches Concat commands.

checks.name: sane_defaults
checks.detail: Installed Windows voice + automatic image pool + Concat; paid API permission is not preselected.

checks.name: speech_preview
checks.detail: Actual WAV returned and readable; voice engine is the declared eSpeak OS fixture.

checks.name: preflight_no_spend
checks.detail: Voice/model catalog/Concat readiness checked before any image or final render.

checks.name: end_to_end_reception
checks.detail: Same reception request produces a reviewed MP4 via Windows speech boundary, A429 -> B image handoff, actual Concat RPC calls and fixture export, then product download and Range decode.

checks.name: refresh_no_duplicate
checks.detail: Refreshing product view does not generate new images or export again.

checks.name: consent_isolation
checks.detail: Paid image permission and request approval are not carried into another project.

checks.name: studio_same_pipeline
checks.detail: Video Studio exposes the same Windows/Concat path as reception.

checks.name: access_controls
checks.detail: Unauthenticated voice enumeration and locked-vault production/product access are refused.

voice: eSpeak vi via test-only Windows boundary; not native Windows
productionCsp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'
